claims.nodeLabel: FY2024 NDAA, Public Law 118-31 - Div. A, Title XVIII, Subtitle C (secs. 1841-1843), UAP Records Collection; Div. G (IAA FY2024) secs. 7341, 7343
claims.sourceText: Public Law 118-31, Sec. 1841 (44 U.S.C. 2107 note), enacted 22 December 2023
claims.text: The UAP Records Collection 'shall consist of record copies of all Government, Government-provided, or Government-funded records relating to unidentified anomalous phenomena, technologies of unknown origin, and non-human intelligence... which shall be transmitted to the National Archives.'

The UAP Records Collection established by NDAA FY2024 Sec. 1841 consists of record copies of all 'Government, Government-provided, or Government-funded records' relating to UAP, technologies of unknown origin and non-human intelligence.
